inv.location: Calle de Juan Duque, Imperial, Arganzuela, Madrid
inv.desc_es:
Inmobiliarias Encuentro vende este local comercial situado en el barrio de Imperial, una zona consolidada de Madrid que destaca por su excelente ubicación, su ambiente residencial y su cercanía a espacios tan emblemáticos como Madrid Río y el entorno del Puente de Toledo. Una ubicación estratégica para desarrollar una actividad comercial o profesional y disfrutar de una zona con múltiples servicios y buenas comunicaciones.

El local cuenta con 32 m2 y se encuentra a pie de calle, ofreciendo un acceso cómodo y directo desde el exterior. Su distribución y características lo convierten en un espacio versátil, con diferentes posibilidades para adaptarlo a las necesidades de cada negocio.

Dispone de instalación eléctrica, suministro de luz y fontanería, además de equipo de aire acondicionado mediante splits con bomba de frío y calor, proporcionando confort durante todo el año.

Su ubicación en Imperial permite disfrutar de un entorno consolidado, con comercios, servicios y todo tipo de establecimientos en las proximidades, además de contar con buenas conexiones mediante transporte público y acceso rápido a otras zonas del centro de Madrid.

Una oportunidad interesante para quienes buscan un local a pie de calle en una zona con actividad y proyección, tanto para establecer un negocio como para plantearlo como inversión.

inv.desc_en:
Inmobiliarias Encuentro sells this commercial space located in the Imperial neighborhood, a consolidated area of Madrid that stands out for its excellent location, its residential atmosphere, and its proximity to iconic spaces such as Madrid Río and the surroundings of the Puente de Toledo. A strategic location to develop a commercial or professional activity and enjoy an area with multiple services and good transport links.

The premises have 32 m2 and are located at street level, offering comfortable and direct access from the outside. Its layout and features make it a versatile space, with different possibilities to adapt it to the needs of each business.

It has electrical installation, electricity and plumbing supply, as well as air conditioning equipment via split units with a heat pump, providing comfort throughout the year.

Its location in Imperial allows you to enjoy a consolidated environment, with shops, services, and all kinds of establishments nearby, in addition to having good connections via public transport and quick access to other areas of central Madrid.

An interesting opportunity for those looking for a street-level space in an area with activity and potential, both to establish a business and to consider it as an investment.

Financing tailored to you! With FINMOO you will get the best interest rates and up to 100% financing. Check our conditions!

At iEncuentro. es we try to improve every day, simplifying the procedures related to the purchase of your new home. You can now reserve any of our properties through the website, quickly and easily, through a totally secure and transparent process.

Are you looking to buy a home and customize it to your liking? Discover REFORTECA. We offer you a unique service for locating and purchasing the home you want, customizing the renovation, and obtaining a mortgage; or if you only need to renovate, we will get you the necessary mortgage financing and provide you with the professionals to carry it out.

No complications, no waiting!
